body: Chief on the P1-1 slice-2 precheck: design ACCEPTED — RemotePolicy.evaluate takes the Embedder[F] (provider and model derived from EmbedderInfo, space resolved through embedder.space, unknown space denied, advertised space under a foreign provider denied before allowlist), capability records only derived identities, no public API left for a caller to assert provider/model separately; the four adversarial laws as listed. CHOICE: version-qualified model identity — policy and capability must not silently survive an endpoint version change; ProviderFingerprint stays the artifact-level proof, and the receipt records both (policy identity = name+version; fingerprint = what actually ran). Add one ADR 0001 D6 sentence for that. Start after P0-2 lands (privacy.scala), rebased on m1's candidate.
